author: David Bombal
description:
Going to a protest? Your digital security starts before you leave home. We discuss phone privacy, disabling biometric unlock, strong passwords and protecting your data when getting involved in activism.

From Flock cameras and surveillance concerns to encrypted messaging, cloud storage and the limitations of VPNs and Tor, this clip explores the digital safety basics every new activist should consider.

What would you change on your phone before attending a protest?

#privacy #cybersecurity #security
title: Going to a Protest? Change THIS on Your Phone
